elements.evidence: The rendered § 19 still binds both parties: "neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement." Customer therefore remains subject to a non-solicit, so the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) is not achieved.
"neither party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other party" — symmetrical obligation binding Vendor and Customer alike.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Scope is limited to "any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement"; the original blanket "any employee of the other party" (plus affiliate extension) is removed.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: "for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of a person's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement" replaces the original term-plus-one-year no-hire tail. Note the retained "During the term of this Agreement and" lead-in could, read literally, keep the restriction alive during the term for a person whose involvement ended more than 12 months earlier; the operative post-involvement anchor is nonetheless the 12-month period required by the checklist, and the total is well inside the 24-month walk-away.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: "does not apply to general advertisements" appears in the proviso.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: "or unsolicited approaches by such persons" is expressly carved out in the same proviso.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: "provided that this Section does not prohibit hiring"; the original "agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire" no-hire language is deleted and replaced with a solicitation-only covenant.

reasons: Finding status "deviation" is correct: the original § 19 was a mutual no-hire covering "any employee of the other party" for the term plus one year with no carve-outs — all-personnel no-hire is walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT, so it fails the fallback on material terms and a redline is warranted.

The redline is position-complete at the fallback: mutuality, direct-involvement scope, 12-month post-involvement duration, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and an express statement that hiring is not prohibited are all present in operative language, not merely promised in the comment.

Preferred level is not met and could not be met by this edit, since a mutual non-solicit still binds Customer; that is acceptable because a clause sitting at the fallback is the intended landing zone here.

Minimality holds: the deletions (all-employee scope, affiliate hiring extension, six-month former-employee lookback, one-year post-term tail) are each required to reach the direct-involvement, no-hire and 12-month elements; no survival tail, expense allocation, remedy or other extraneous term was added.
Intent preserved: the clause remains a single self-contained covenant with no dangling cross-reference or undefined term, and no other commercial mechanic is disturbed.

Optional tightening (not a failure): consider deleting "During the term of this Agreement and" or recasting as "during the term and for twelve (12) months after the end of a person's involvement, whichever ends later than 12 months after involvement ends is excluded", so the term-based lead-in cannot be read to extend the restriction beyond 12 months after a person's involvement ends.
